s730a3227bd0d4a: Question four: Is the distributed training "Access" HAMi supporting multi-machine Doca distribution training? Supporting cross-host and cross-cards?
sb00f91f4640a41: In the AI training area, single machine cards are often difficult to meet the resource requirements of large models, and distributed training becomes a “necessary option” for improving the efficiency of training. So, is HAMi capable of performing the task of distributed training?
sf82c9ef147d260: Of course! HAMi perfectly supports multi-machine Doca distribution training.
s694c1ae0559182: Multi-machine Doc: Cross-host and cross-card collaboration through K8s Scheduling Pods to different nodes, each of which uses its own GPU resources, and through distributed computing frameworks (e.g. PyToch, TensorFlow, Horovod, etc.).
s718cf7eb8ee8e4: Cross-host: Multiple Pods run on different nodes, with efficient communication between nodes through high performance networks (e.g. NCCL or RDMA), synchronize gradients and update parameters.
s029d234ab4de47: Cross-card: Single Pod can use multiple GPUs at the same node to calculate in parallel and accelerate the training process.
s25adaca6b2a438: The " Single Pod Cross Host" scenario is not supported:
s91c1f84f9d9080: K8s design principle: Pod must run on a single node, which cannot be distributed across multiple machines.
s68a7c5d5803827: HAMi is not currently a remote caller programme.
s435b9044ea787d: Solutions: If cross-host resource collaboration is required, multi-Pod distributed training should be used and carried out by a distributed framework coordinated across-host missions.

s74f53dad972cf5: Question six: Device Plugin is a lot of things. Why do the DP users, some HAMi did it by themselves?
s02a1f3a1dbae6d: Different manufacturers also show different technical paths in the realization of Device Plugin. Some make direct use of officially available Device Plugin, others do so themselves. What is this?
s0c67fb73a93849: The “All-in-one” strategy of the national manufacturer: Some domestic producers (e.g. Iluvatar CoreX, Hygon, Cambricon) have already “manually” completed equipment detection and mounted functions directly. Therefore, no additional Runtime is needed to assist them.
sd3c50e82e2a761: NVIDIA and Ascend uses the “division of labour” model: both NVIDIA and China use the “division of labour” model. Device Plugin focuses on resource reporting and allocation, while Runtime is responsible for environmental configuration, equipment nodes mounted and advanced functional support. This model is more modular and has clearer responsibilities.
s9b620bb90479a6: Why would there be a Device Plugin that needs official, some HAMi to do it on its own:
sba1f6c86fd747d: The official Device Plugin's “restrictiveness”: the resource information provided by the official Device Plugin may be “unutilized” to meet some of the high-level characteristics of HAMi, or the design of the official Device Plugin interface would add additional complexity to Scheduler's suitability.
sf600937615c095: The need for HAMi to “self-reliance”: in order to be flexible in controlling the behaviour of Device Plugin, obtain more information about resources and simplify Scheduler's adaptation, HAMi chose “self-reliance”, achieving a different score from its card, Device Plugin.
s768cb21b3b60eb: Official Ascend Device Plugin: Each card type requires the corresponding complex management of Device Plugin. Thus, Hami abstracted all card types in a cut-off template and achieved a Device Plugin to handle different card templates and facilitate synergy with Scheduler.
s07137471249b0d: NVIDIA Official Device Plugin: Limited resource information is available, and HAMi needs more information to achieve more advanced features (such as the caps of the Compute Resourcees GPU memory, supercompendence, NUMA perception, etc.) and therefore Device Plugin needs to be implemented on its own.
s2373310e57bbb5: Summary: The choice of how to achieve Device Plugin depends on the manufacturer’s technical route, the trade-off between functionality and flexibility, and an integrated strategy with K8s ecology. Hami has made the best choices in terms of her needs and objectives.
